about: A client tag on the root level's start dialogue: ecl::GameStatePrepareRunning::Update queries eoc::ServerRootLevelStartDialogComponent without and with it (and eoc::ServerRootLevelLoadedComponent without it) - the client's PrepareRunning says when the level's start dialogue may begin.

evidence.says: macOS ecl::GameStatePrepareRunning::Update holds the query spec <ServerRootLevelStartDialogComponent> without <ClientRootLevelStartDialogReadyComponent>; RegisterQueryDescription entries name the other two.
The executable keeps this type's name as text

questions.ask: Whether FastLoadStreamingWait (PrepareRunning ended at its first update) adds this tag later than the game would - the arrival cinematic and the courier's death land after LevelGameplayStarted with it - and whether a headless WLD arrival's stall after its cinematic comes from it.
